notes.title: The new July version of "Xuan Nv Zhu Demon Record" will be updated soon
notes.content:
Hello, Steam players. In the latest update, we have optimized and optimized the problems, mechanisms, BUGs, etc. in the game. The updated products will be released on the 7.22 update.
Game optimization:
1. Solve the problem of stuttering in the game
2. Solve the problem of unlimited loading in the game

System modification:
1. Reduce the hard time after launching an attack.
2. Increased aerial and under-air attacks.
3. The pause time of the soul is cancelled.
4. After the character dies, the gold coin penalty will be changed from all the original gold coins to 50%.

In-game quality optimization:
1. Modified the sending gate mechanism. Now there is no capacity limitation for exploring sending, and it can be sent afterwards.
2. The switch of the organ has been enlarged
3. Ask for gold coins after defeating the boss
4. Part of the structure has been modified, and the game flow will now be more friendly.
5. The UI of the character's HP has been modified, now it looks better!
6. The positions of some treasures and materials have been modified to make the game experience more reasonable.

BUG repair:
1. The bug of modification and replacement has been fixed
2. The bug of the handle has been fixed
3. The bug of jam wall has been fixed
4. The bug of passing through the door has been fixed

Add a new area-Fire Cave,
Add a new area-Desolation Abyss
The new BOSS-Ziying!
New ability-now you can become a cat!

notes.title: Update March 11th
notes.content:
In Case there are some players who don’t read Chinese，we make an English version of the patch note.
It‘s mainly translated using Google，so we do apologies for this and any other further poor translations.

Note that this is a functional patch, which does not include the update of the game content. If you have cleared all the previous content, you don't have to rush to open the game. Bugs not listed below may not be fixed.

[H3] function adjustment: [/ H3]

Add Imperfect DualShork4 support, will be fixed in further update.
Add a new attack action, slightly optimized attack animations.
The jumping trajectory is adjusted, now it’s easier to reach the max jumping height.
Picking up souls no longer stops the game, but health restoration is half reduced.
The portal function has been added. You can defeat  the current final Boss and gain the ability to active the portals.


[H3] bug fix: [/ H3]

Fixed a Bug that the health balls drop by Boss can be picked up repeatedly. We will recall those health balls that were picked up incorrectly in the future.
Fixed the problem of the missing function of the change key menu. Now you can use the mouse button and most of the keys on the keyboard. The ESC key becomes the new default exit key.

[H3] next [H3]

We will focus on the content update in the next period of time. We expect to update the next level in mid April. Thank you for your understanding and support. Please look forward to it.

notes.title: Some thoughts on the follow-up update of "Xuannu Zhumolu" (1)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,:
        We are the development team of "Xuan Nu Zhu Mo Lu". It has been a month since the game EA was officially launched on February 8. During this month, we made a lot of new friends and collected a lot of opinions and ideas. Thank you very much. The three-legged cat will continue with new content and new [strike]bug[/strike] with 100% enthusiasm and confidence, and strive to correct existing problems, and bring you really fun and interesting Castlevania-like games. The following is the official content of our first article, which also proves that we did not run away (by mistake).
        Today, we are going to talk to you about some ideas for the follow-up update of "Xuan Nu".
       In the upcoming update (the specific time is determined by the amount of hair remaining in my group’s program elder brother, who is distressed about his hair), in addition to fixing annoying bugs and adding more handle support, we will respond to the voice of the masses and respond to the current situation. There is an attack from Miss Xuan Nv, and the jumping feel is optimized. In addition, we will also bring new abilities to Miss Xuan Nv ----- Teleport!

    Please stay tuned!
     In addition, we have also prepared a batch of conceptual maps of future capabilities for everyone. You can guess how we will use these new abilities in games and interact with new games.
In our vision, Miss Xuan Nv has nine different auras, corresponding to nine different abilities. In addition to the fire aura fireball that everyone has already played, the wind aura moves in the air, and the earth aura climbs the wall, we will be in the future. Will also provide ice aura, thunder aura, ***, ***, etc.
       Today, we will bring you some ideas and designs on ice spirit.
As we all know, fire must come from ice. If fire aura can burn everything and destroy enemies and obstacles, then what ice aura can do is freeze everything!
       In order to achieve the idea of ??"freezing everything", we designed new mechanisms and new attack methods. Players use ice aura to perform other interesting operations, and they can use ice to climb to places that they could not reach before. Yes, freeze The ice cubes afterwards can be climbed. I really like this idea. Our planning is really great. Of course, ice cubes can be climbed so they can definitely be smashed by fireballs. After a period of time, they will definitely melt away. This is very physical. There is no picture without the truth. Below, please see the conceptual picture we planned to bring to you:

       I hope everyone likes the concept map we brought to you, and I hope you can put forward more ideas in the comment area. If we see it (we will definitely read every one) and adopt it, we will have a surprise to offer, and Add your name to the special thanks in the game!

To be a preview, the next follow-up update idea series article, we will bring you the design concept of Lei Lingqi, and bring you new capabilities to decrypt. A reminder: Miss Xuannv’s cat ears, is it a card issuer?
